source_text: Yes, the pop effect works now, but it should be static and full-size relative to its raised element when the mouse moves or it makes me sea-sick.  We could increase its size / decrease its boundary a bit to make "full size" legible.  SCAN confirmed to be placed as desired.

fragments.text: Yes, the pop effect works now,
but it should be static and full-size relative to its raised element when the mouse moves or it makes me sea-sick.
We could increase its size / decrease its boundary a bit to make "full size" legible.
SCAN confirmed to be placed as desired.

reply_text:
㊥ ("it should be static and full-size relative to its raised element") Done. The enlarged box now shows the whole drawing and nothing moves when the pointer moves. It is committed on futon7a `master` as `ffa1204` and not pushed.

㊢ ("increase its size / decrease its boundary a bit") The box now takes up to 92% of the window's width and height, where it was 80%. It has the drawing's own proportions, so the whole drawing fits in it.
- **At 1600 by 900:** the box is 1472 by 617, against 1260 by 528 in the page. That is about 17% larger each way.
- **Margin:** 4% of the window's width on each side (64 px at 1600), and more above and below. Moving the pointer into any of it closes the box, as before.
- **Sliding code:** removed entirely from the embedded page, not just switched off.

㊬ (what I checked) I served the site locally and drove Chromium with Playwright at 1600 by 900. Every check passed and the page raised no errors.
- **Still:** the SCAN box is at the same position before and after moving the pointer across the box.
- **Aim:** clicking R16 in the enlarged view now selects R16. With sliding it had landed on SCAN.
- **Open and close:** the margin, Escape, no reopen loop, a quick pass not opening, and a narrow window staying inline all still pass.
- **Phone with a mouse:** the emulated case still opens for a mouse and not for a finger.

I looked at a screenshot of the enlarged box: the box titles and column headings read easily, and the small module names under each box are readable but still small.

㊟ (how much "full size" can gain) The gain is limited because the figure in the page is already about 79% of the window's width. The remaining option for making the small labels larger is to change the drawing itself, for example larger label text in the generator. Say if you want that.

㊢ ("SCAN confirmed to be placed as desired") Noted; nothing further on that. The derivation script in futon7 is updated to match (`f6df29d`).

🈸 (to see it) `git push origin master` in futon7a, then reload the About page.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text: ("Maybe it's just my setup") I had the box open only on devices that report hover support, to keep it off phones. A phone reports "no hover" even with a mouse attached, so on your Pixel it never opened. It now opens for any mouse or pen pointer, on any device, and not for a finger.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text: (the Pixel case) I ran a browser set up as a phone, with touch on and hover reported as absent. A finger tap does not open the box, a mouse on the same device does, and the margin closes it. This is an emulation; I could not test your Pixel itself.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text:
("SCAN" should probably go under ACT) Done in the figure's generator in p4ng, so it survives regeneration.
- **Layout:** SCAN is drawn at the foot of the ACT column, below R16, and the "(no stage)" column is gone.
- **Size:** the drawing is 1730 wide instead of 2060, so the figure in the page is drawn about 19% larger and the labels are easier to read.
- **Tooltip:** hovering SCAN says "not on the control map; drawn under ACT". I did not record SCAN as an ACT-stage node in the stage data. That data is read off the hand-drawn control map, and SCAN is not on it.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text:
(what I checked for the figure)
- Before my change, a scratch run of the generator reproduced the tracked page byte for byte, so the regenerated diff is the layout only.
- The generator's own checks pass (`test_gen_lean_dag.sh`: all cases ok).
- The earlier hover checks all pass at the new proportions, at 1600 by 900.
- I looked at a screenshot of the new figure in the page: five columns, SCAN under R16, the lower band and the R20 boundary intact.
